mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the wet or water saturated portions of the earth."
The hydrosphere is the wet or water saturated portions of the earth.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those natural and man-induced (anthropogenic) processes which create an accident or extreme event or damage to all organisms in the ecosystem."
Environmental hazards are those natural and man-induced (anthropogenic) processes which create an accident or extreme event or damage to all organisms in the ecosystem.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the study of all physical features of the earth's surface including its climate and the distribution of plants, animals and human life."
Geography is concerned with the study of all physical features of the earth's surface including its climate and the distribution of plants, animals and human life.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sudden motion of the ground surface, ranging from a faint tremor to a wild motion capable of shaking buildings apart and causing gaping fissures to open in the ground."

Earthquakes/Volcanic Activities An earthquake is a sudden motion of the ground surface, ranging from a faint tremor to a wild motion capable of shaking buildings apart and causing gaping fissures to open in the ground.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of the earth particularly the interrelationships between the lithosphere, hydrosphere and biosphere."
Environmental geoscience is the study of the earth particularly the interrelationships between the lithosphere, hydrosphere and biosphere.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the disintegration of rocks due to the actions of water, wind or man."
Weathering is the disintegration of rocks due to the actions of water, wind or man.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most visible effect of erosion in parts of Nigeria underlain by sedimentary rocks while areas underlain by hard basement complex rocks exhibit inselbergs and whalebacks as remnants of erosion."

Gully erosion is the most visible effect of erosion in parts of Nigeria underlain by sedimentary rocks while areas underlain by hard basement complex rocks exhibit inselbergs and whalebacks as remnants of erosion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of the naturally occurring inorganic substances that have definite chemical composition and physical character/structure."
Mineralogy is the study of the naturally occurring inorganic substances that have definite chemical composition and physical character/structure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the loss of water in the liquid state to the gaseous state as a result of changes in temperature."
Evaporation is the loss of water in the liquid state to the gaseous state as a result of changes in temperature.
